        return flow
    i = head[node]
    while i != 0 and flow > 0:
        to_node = edges[i]['to']
        if edges[i]['flow'] > 0 and dist[to_node // 2][to_node % 2] == dist[node // 2][node % 2] + 1:
            a = dfs(to_node, min(edges[i]['flow'], flow))
            if a > 0:
                edges[i]['flow'] -= a
                edges[i ^ 1]['flow'] += a
                flow -= a
                total_flow += a
        i = edges[i]['prev']
    if total_flow == 0:
        dist[node // 2][node % 2] = INF
    return total_flow

    total_flow = 0
    while bfs():
        flow = dfs(source, INF)
        while flow:
            total_flow += flow
            flow = dfs(source, INF)
    return total_flow
